messages.subject: test of fixed effects
parts:
Hi Guys, 

How do we test the fixed effects using breedR?

On asreml-R there is the function called wald(). 

Is there something similar? 

Thank you

messages.author: 37c4b6bc71d5d203
messages.subject: Re: [breedR] test of fixed effects
parts:
Hi Roberto.

The short answer is no, there is nothing provided to help in that endeavour.

First, because I don't think a NHST approach is really helpful or
meaningful in most settings, and I'm not interested in fostering the
common misconceptions around it (i.e. that smaller p indicates stronger
relationship and that statistical significance indicates practical
importance).

Second, because breedR is quite limited (limitation inherited from the
underlying computational libraries) in the specification of contrasts or
alternative parameterizations of the fixed components. Thus, it is not
very useful to have the ability of conducting NHST if you have no
control of what exactly to test.

Of course, you are free to manually compute your statistics and perform
any tests you like. I'd be glad to include contributed code after some
revition and validation, if people finds it useful.


Best wishes

ƒacu.-
